notes.title: Final Major Update
notes.content:
Hey, so this is gonna probably be the final update for Necrolepsy. There's some details as to why this is the final at the bottom. For now, here are the changes!

Additions:

-Added optimizations to Ctarl Caves. The stage ran a lot more poorly before, now it's much more optimized akin to Fortune Fortress.
(Shanoa Sanctuary and May Mansion didn't benefit from these optimizations (no frame rate increases or ram usage subtracted) so haven't been included)
-Brand new library and asset art for the game, since I've gotten a lot better at drawing so here ya go.

Fixes:

-Fixed a variety of incorrect placements or distortions of textures. (Thanks ICO!)
-Enemies can no longer collide with each other.

Other notes:

Thank you all for the wonderful 3 years of getting my feet into the door of video game development, but I need to focus on my next project. I'm probably not going to update Necrolepsy for a very long time now. My next project, [url=https://www.patreon.com/dracoblood]Dracoblood[/url], is shaping up to be much better and I want to be able to focus squarely on it. I've pretty much fixed every issue with this game that wouldn't involve re-writing the entire game's code (something that would be REALLY fun to do but way too time consuming). Other issues will be put on a backburner to get back to in the future when [url=https://www.patreon.com/dracoblood]Dracoblood [/url]doesn't occupy my very limited time.

notes.title: 2nd Anniversary Patch
notes.content:
Yeah cool! Happy Anniversary Necrolepsy. Here's some bug fixes I've been meaning to add but haven't had a chance to till now.

Fixes:
-Fixed some glitches with the Dash Light Beast where he wouldn't reset properly after both resting and stunned modes. Now properly resets.
-Fixed a glitch where the Lamia was invincible when in a mode where she shouldn't be.
-Fixed an animation issue where Lira would not do her spear throw.
-Fixed some textures rotated the wrong way in Ctarl Caves.

notes.title: Anniversary Update & Sale!
notes.content:
Happy anniversary to my pride and joy, Necrolepsy. It's my first commercial game ever made so I want to make sure it gets some special attention around its release date. With that, Necrolepsy is going to be on sale for ONE DOLLAR. After the sale, it will then be permanently priced to 6.99! 

This update also had a new artist join the fray, and I had to adjust the credits for him and some other things like better crediting on my part, since I did do like, everything on this game, but there's some things I didn't do.

One more thing before I go, Necrolepsy is my [i]first game[/i], because I'm making a second game, an Action RPG called Dracoblood! It's being funded via Patreon and I'm definitely making sure it's not going to suffer obscurity issues that Necrolepsy has with marketing. So if you want to check it out (and play the prototype so you know what you're getting), [url=https://www.patreon.com/dracoblood]you can check out Dracoblood at this link![/url]

Now on to the patch notes, have fun playing!

Gameplay:
-Added some clauses to make sure nightmare doesn't activate in Milly Marathon without Always Nightmare being activated. That's a phantom issue so make sure you tell me if it happens again.
-Changed the grindstone's location in Ctarl Caves to not be underwater so you don't drown while reading if it's your first one you're getting, lol.
-Added tutorial prompts about the map, combat basics and other things.
-You no longer need the Claymore to destroy projectiles, it's native at the beginning of the game.
-Fixed a glitch where you could use the Saw blade while sliding.
-Redesigned a little bit of Ctarl Caves to make certain parts easier.

Art & Sound: 
-Adjusted some of the art in Ctarl Caves
-Changed the Game Over graphic, thank you for making that, JamoART!
-Added a new animation for the Power Slide ability.
-Added some sound effects (door opening sounds, Cash register sounds)
-Added sound effects when battling the Saw Light Beast

Boss Adjustments:
-Adjusted a part in the Wraith Lord's Wake Me Up Difficulty fight so that you don't get hit doing a specific sawblade move.
-Fixed a glitch with the Saw Light Beast that didn't increase his speed properly relative to his health (was dividing ints, my b on that one).
-Fixed another glitch that kept adding counters to the Saw Light Beast when fighting him, making him sometimes attack stationary.

Misc:
-Added some lore as to why Bart sells incredibly dangerous magic items.
-Modified the credits (name changed, added another artist).

notes.title: Hey some fun fixes because a popular guy streamed the game, lol.
notes.content:

notes.title: Fortune Fortress Optimization patch
notes.content:
-Fixed the main menu's loading prompt having a layering problem with the filters and stage on areas.
-Fixed a few spelling issues.
Fortune Fortress:
	-Optimized the area a bit better by making some scripts abide to macro scripts (so 1 script does the lifting instead of 600 (Don't ask why that happened, I just forgot)).
	-Added some general object optimization to make the stage run much smoother
	-Fixed an issue with the Black Necromancer's AI that made him not follow you on his first attack.

One of my best friends from college pointed out that he had some optimization issues on the game in Fortune Fortress, and he wasn't the only one, despite the fact that this game uses little ram, it still used a lot of little processing power. So I devised something that should be REALLY optimized for slower machines. Now wait for the patch where I have to fix it again ahahaha.

-removed a few enemies in May Mansion.

-changes to the final boss:
	*Wraith Lord doesn't stop in place for 2 seconds now.
	*Wraith Lord will stop in place for 2 seconds in the boss rush.
	*Made the Wraith Lord's decision making much faster, making the fight much faster in general.

When's the next update? Not sure. Right now I'm focusing on advertising the game like mad. I've been talking to a lot of reviewers and trying to make the game catch on a bit more. While the reception for Necrolepsy has been positive (Thank you very much!), the sales have been extremely slow burning, so I'm going to contact some more people and see if we can arrange some details. There's an error with unity's collision detection that may cause Lira to fall through random pieces of collision at random times. If this happens, I'd advise you to reset the game by exiting to the main menu 

and reloading the save. This error is inconsistent so it's difficult to fix via code, so I've got a different and slightly more practical solution for it for the next update. I apologize if this has happened

LUCKILY, if things go well, the next game won't be using that as a controller.

notes.title: Current Affairs: June 18th
notes.content:
Hello, I hope you guys are enjoying Bloodstained or any other fun game of your choosing today. I'm here to add some updates as to the development for Necrolepsy.

[h1]Programming[/h1]

So first thing's first, the coding is done! That's right, every single thing in the game that is coded is implemented and works. Everything that's important is 100% done, but there are some things that will need bug fixing. That means the majority of the game's progress is art related, so let me answer some things with that.

[h1]Art[/h1]

So with art: NONE of the artists are done, this includes myself and the two animators I hired for production. They are both working very hard and I'm trying to work as hard as them, but I didn't go to art school, so some things are a bit harder for me to make. This means the game will be delayed again at some point, but I will make sure that this delay will become the [b]VERY LAST DELAY[/b] because I am getting sick of working on this game. Not in the sense that I don't like the game anymore, far from it, but more so the stuff that I'm working on has nothing to do with what I'm actually experienced in (programming, game design) and it's art stuff. I'm maintaining what I can but holy cow do I complain every day about it, wouldn't trade it for the world though.

Next with art: The majority of it has been redone, and I've invented a few things that have helped with making it easier to be detailed. I've made randomly generating tiles and I've also made some things that have helped tremendously with making textures stay interesting. I'm very hell bent on making sure people look at this game and say "hey this is pretty great" as a hook, but I'm sure the gameplay will keep you going.

[h1]Trailer[/h1]

I know I promised a trailer for June, and I feel like crap for not delivering on that, but there's been some reasons for it, mainly the art not being done and I can't bring myself to show the game off again yet. I want to work more on the art and make sure more things are in the game first.

[h1]Music and Sound[/h1]

The composer for the game has decided to get an upgrade, and for free, within his spare time, he's been making remasters of the game's soundtrack with more modern keyboards and sounds. You can expect some extremely high quality music now to keep you entertained, so expect that for the trailer to have too.

Sound effects have been mostly made, there's just a few to finish up to keep the game interesting and fresh. Most of the gameplay sounds are slapped in there and sound fantastic, you'll get a kick out of how the game sounds.

[h1]Any Other Notes:[/h1]

There has been some slow production due to a lot of personal things that have gone on that I won't go into detail about. Lots of tears shed since I was able to work full time on this game. Most of it is over now, but I'm doing what I can to keep myself active and get the game out.

notes.title: Current Update - May 16th
notes.content:
Sorry for the lack of updates, both on twitter and in general. A lot of the stuff that's been going on with Necrolepsy isn't as exciting as "oh wow cool locations" and art style stuff, so sadly I've been very down-low on updates.

Basically, almost all the coding is done. I like how I keep saying this but most of the bugs the game had have been patched out and functionality with everything should be working. Figured out how to get cloud saving and achievements working among other things and making sure this game *feels* complete. I mean, it should, but yeah. Been trying to push the beta testers to play through the game now since there's tons more enemies and the game is overall harder, so there's been testing going on there to make the game pretty long lasting.

What's left for art? Basically easy but time consuming stuff. I've hired a second artist as I said before who's been working on 3 of the other bosses. Right now I have to finish up 6 of them, technically 7 given alternative forms, but otherwise it's those guys. First animator's finishing up the rest of the enemies, and I have to finish up another enemy. Backgrounds have been worked on and tons of changes have been made there. Three Levels need some finishing touches and one level needs their tile set made but overall, the game's getting nearly done when it comes to art, which is what's preventing it from being really close to release. LOL I should rotoscope sprites next time, at least that's easier.

There's been some production issues on my end, I have to upgrade my computer prematurely (was hoping profits from this game would do that first, whoops) and finally got a SSD after years of waiting, quite a difficult process to get windows installed on it, but I did, even though like 5% things still don't work on it, it's working.

So basically, the majority of the game is still art, but it's much further along. I'm going to be finishing up many areas art wise and patch up lots of stuff music and audio wise and we should be good. My composer wants to do a different take on the soundtrack but haven't heard much from the first impression he gave. Anyway, see ya next time, I'm going to have a trailer before June so get excited, cause it's gonna get weird.
